message: Boundary Allow statement 'AllowDataCatalogRead' grants cross-account-capable actions (glue:getdatabase, glue:getdatabases, glue:gettable (+1 more)) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.
